extended:
**ASYMPTOTICS OF CHARACTERS OF SYMMETRIC GROUPS: STRUCTURE OF KEROV CHARACTER POLYNOMIALS**

*MACIEJ DOŁ ˛ EGA AND PIOTRŚNIADY*

26 pp, 18 sections.

**Abstract.** We study asymptotics of characters of the symmetric groups on a ﬁxed conjugacy class. It was proved by Kerov that such a character can be expressed as a polynomial in free cumulants of the Youn g dia- gram (certain functionals describing the shape of the Young diagram). We show that for each genus there exists a universal symmetric polyno- mial which gives the coefﬁcients of the part of Kerov charact er polyno- mials with the prescribed homogeneous degree. The existenc e of such symmetric polynomials was conjectured by Lassalle. 1. I NTRODUCTION 1.1. Asymptotic representation theory of symmetric groups. What can we say about the representations of the symmetric groups S(n) in the limit n → ∞ ? This very general question is the subject of investigations of the asymptotic representation theory of the symmetric groups.

**Outline.** 1.1 Asymptotic representation theory of symmet; 1.2 Asymptotic shape of Young diagrams; 1.3 How to normalize the characters?; 1.6 Kerov character polynomials; 1.4 How to describe the shape of a Young diagr; 1.5 Free cumulants; 1.7 Genus expansion; 1.8 The main result: proof of some conjectures; 1.9 General idea of the proof; 2.3 Goulden-Rattan formula; 3.1 Implications of divisibility; 3.2 Divisibility; 3.3 Proof of the main result; 4 Technical lemmas; 4.1 Identities on symmetric functions; 4.3 Arithmetic properties of Kerov polynomials; Acknowledgments; References
